nodes.title: Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. your picture)
Prompt Pixaroma (3. keep the first sentence, describe the scene)

promptState.text: Outpaint the image: replace the solid gray areas with a seamless continuation of the scene, keeping the existing picture unchanged. Scene: a sunny terrace of a white Greek island house with a red tile roof, a blue wooden door and blue shutters, a wicker armchair with a beige cushion, a small wooden side table with a potted aloe, a stone floor, a white terrace wall, and behind it the rocky coastline and the calm blue sea under a clear blue sky with a few small white clouds.

{"version":1,"content":"

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 FLUX 3 needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer, the first version with FLUX 3. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no flux3 type and some nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 FLUX 3 needs a free approval first (one time only)

Black Forest Labs keeps the FLUX 3 files behind a short approval on Hugging Face. Until you do it, every FLUX 3 download link below answers "Access to model ... is restricted ... Please log in".

  1. Log in to Hugging Face (a free account).
  2. Open the FLUX 3 model page with the button below and click Agree and access repository. Access is given at once.
  3. Now the download links below work, in the same browser.

FLUX 3 Klein on Hugging Face 

 Downloading with ComfyUI-Manager or a script needs a Hugging Face token as well (hf auth login). In the browser, being logged in is enough.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors5.83 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist.

Take the file WITHOUT base in its name: that is the distilled (fast) model these workflows use. The files with base in the name are the base model, made for training LoRAs: it needs CFG 3.5 and 25 to 50 steps, and at the settings here (15 or 16 steps, CFG 1) its pictures come out smeared and broken.

Already have flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors? That is the same file under its first name (ComfyUI's own template used it at launch). Pick it in this node instead of downloading it again.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors4.86 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae.safetensors336 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

The same file as Flux 2 Klein: if you have it, skip this one.

 License

FLUX 3 Image Klein is released under the FLUX Kommunity License. You may use the pictures commercially only while your yearly revenue (all the money coming in, before costs), together with any company you belong to, is under US$5 million. Read it before you use the model for paid work.

FLUX 3 Klein model page 

 LoRA Loader Pixaroma (the outpaint LoRA)

Download flux-3-image-klein-outpaint.safetensors161 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/loras/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist. Made by ausboss for FLUX 3 Image Klein and shared under the same FLUX Kommunity License.

Outpaint LoRA page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.218). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Make a picture wider or taller: FLUX 3 paints more of the scene around it, and your picture stays exactly as it is in the middle. The demo turns a square photo of a Greek house into a wide 16:9 picture with more of the coast and the terrace.

 Steps

  1. Load your picture in Load Image Mini Pixaroma.
  2. On Outpaint Pixaroma, pick the new shape, or add space to the sides you want.
  3. In Prompt Pixaroma, keep the first sentence and change the part after Scene: to describe your picture.
  4. Leave the seed on F to repeat a result, or switch it to R to try a new one every Run.
  5. Press Run.

 How it works

  • Outpaint Pixaroma puts flat grey bands around your picture and makes the whole canvas about 1 megapixel.
  • FLUX 3, with the outpaint LoRA, paints the grey bands with more of the scene. Its instruction is the first sentence of the prompt.
  • Outpaint Stitch puts your original picture back on top at full size, so only the new bands are painted.

 Good to know

  • In our tests the grey was filled on all 4 seeds, and the join could not be seen at 100%.
  • Without the LoRA it also worked on the demo picture, but the LoRA's copy of the picture was closer to the original, and its author measured plain FLUX 3 sliding or zooming the picture in 36 of 40 runs. Keep it on.
  • The new bands are painted at about 1 megapixel and enlarged, so up close they are softer than your picture.
  • The LoRA was made for pictures that fill 45 to 93% of the new canvas. For a much bigger extension, run it again on the result.
  • The result is bigger than your picture: the demo's 1600 x 1600 photo becomes 2844 x 1600.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (FLUX 3 Klein, distilled) - The image model, FLUX 3 Image Klein from Black Forest Labs, the distilled version (no base in the file name): 16 steps for an edit, CFG 1. It makes a picture from words AND changes a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 4B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something FLUX 3 understands. The type must be flux3.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE) - Turns the finished render into a picture. FLUX 3 uses the same VAE as Flux 2.
  • LoRA Loader Pixaroma (the outpaint LoRA, 1.5) - Holds the outpaint LoRA by ausboss at strength 1.5, the strength its author tested on the distilled model. It teaches FLUX 3 to fill the grey bands and leave your picture where it is.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. your picture) - The picture to extend. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Outpaint Pixaroma (2. the new shape) - Adds flat grey #808080 bands around your picture up to the new shape, here 16:9 from a square picture, and makes the whole canvas about 1 megapixel, the size the LoRA was made for. Pick another shape or add space to any side on the node. Keep the grey and the 1 megapixel limit.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (3. keep the first sentence, describe the scene) - The first sentence is the LoRA's own instruction: leave it exactly as it is. After Scene:, describe what is in your picture.
  • Seed Pixaroma (4. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) repeats the result, R (random) tries a new one every Run. The demo uses seed 2.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs between the steps.

  • Outpaint Stitch Pixaroma (puts your picture back) - Makes the result as big as the padded canvas at full size and puts your ORIGINAL picture back in the middle, so that part stays exactly your picture. Only the new bands are FLUX 3's. A 64 px soft edge and a colour match hide the join.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the edit prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. FLUX 3 distilled runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Set Reference Multi Latent (the padded canvas, keep resolution) - Hands the padded canvas to FLUX 3 at its own size (keep resolution, the LoRA's setting), for the prompt and for the empty negative. It also gives the KSampler its blank canvas, the size of the padded canvas.
  • KSampler (16 steps) - The edit: 16 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings of Black Forest Labs' own FLUX 3 Klein distilled edit workflow.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the result) - Saves each result as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Flux 3 Klein Outpaint and shows it on the node.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
One outpaint (the canvas at about 1 megapixel)about 6 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (FLUX 3, its text encoder and the outpaint LoRA, about 11 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
